name: Palisade
card: Peaches, wine, and a town that gets a seasonal rush on the east side of the valley.
near: It is east of Grand Junction, against the Book Cliffs.
metaTitle: Palisade Websites and Local SEO | Nick Perry Digital
metaDescription: Websites and local SEO for Palisade businesses, including seasonal shops and year-round services. Prices posted. No long-term contract.
body:
Palisade draws people for peaches, wine, and the orchards, then goes quieter. A year-round contractor and a tasting room do not need the same homepage, even if they share a zip code.

I will ask when your busy season is and which searches pay you in the off season. The Google listing should not promise hours or services you only offer in August.
businesses: Trades that serve Palisade and the east valley
Shops that live on both locals and visitors
extraQ: Do seasonal businesses need a different setup?
extraA: The site can speak to the season without going dark the rest of the year. Hours on the Google listing need to match what a visitor finds at the door. I would rather show a shorter season than collect bad visits.
